title: Event Presence Prospecting
one_line: Find which conferences a company sponsors, exhibits at, or speaks at, and use that as a budget and audience signal.
description: Find which conferences a company sponsors, exhibits at, or speaks at, and use that as a budget and audience signal. Use when someone wants event based prospecting, wants to know if a prospect will be at a show, or is planning outreach around a conference.
paragraph: Event presence is an unusually honest signal because it costs money and it is public. A company that buys a booth has both budget and a stated audience. This skill finds the events, separates sponsorship from attendance from speaking, and builds outreach that is timed to the event rather than generic.
keywords: will this company be at the show

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: event-presence-index 0.005 USD per company.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
